name: ka_auto_c2_beacon
why: AUTO-TRIAGE row (tier-1 phase A gate): the auto_triage op's own prompt and record shape,
on the C2-beacon world. Nobody is watching, so the turn must end on a delivered
true_positive verdict AND a staged containment card: that card is what puts the alert
in the review queue. A right verdict with nothing staged reaches no human at all.
